APPROVE
The split leaves `InScript` at about 2 and each helper at 4 or less, and the logic and the order sites are added in are unchanged (`continue` became `if (close >= 0)`); the one thing I couldn't check, because the source file isn't available here, is whether the new parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`, `List<Site>`) match the original locals, which is the one way this could break the build.
